title: ADM+S researcher appointed ANZSOG Academic Fellow for 2027
headline: ADM+S researcher appointed ANZSOG Academic Fellow for 2027
summary: Dr Bello y Villarino from the ARC Centre of Excellence for Automated Decision-Making and Society has been appointed as an ANZSOG Academic Fellow for 2027. The fellowship will focus on examining the governance, regulation, and procurement of artificial intelligence and automated decision-making systems within the public sector.
why_it_matters: Organisations navigating public sector AI deployment should note that incoming academic research will closely examine government procurement and regulation of automated decision-making systems.

quotes.text: Dr Bello y Villarino will focus on the governance, regulation and procurement of artificial intelligence and automated decision-making systems in the public sector
The 2027 cohort of Academic Fellows will examine a range of pressing policy challenges, including public-sector AI

classification.significance_reason: Appoints a key Australian researcher to examine public sector AI governance and procurement.
